name: zswarm
description: zSwarm — coordinate CLI crews in Zellij panes (list, send, dump).

interface.longDescription: List Zellij panes, send prompts into another CLI pane, and dump scrollback. Local Zellij only.
defaultPrompt: Use zswarm({op:"list"}) to see panes, then zswarm({op:"send", to, body}) to message another CLI in Zellij.
Use zswarm({op:"dump", to}) sparingly for a short screen read; prefer small dumps over full scrollback.
